title: Finite-free scalar squares for chosen compact-support composition and refinement
statement: Let A,B be finite commutative rings, with B finite free over A along phi. Let X→Y→Z be separated finite-type morphisms of noetherian schemes. Choose compactifications c,d,e of f,g,fg. On either site, let K have a retained bounded-below etale origin alpha:realization(L)≅K and let beta:realization(N)≅S_X K be a retained scalar origin. Then the concrete coefficientMap commutes with composition(c,d,e,L,alpha) and with refinement(r,L,alpha), for every refinement r:c′→c [def-pur-finite-free-compact-support-data]. These are only the two geometric equations, not the scalar/site square, invertibility, naturality, or existence of origins.

proof.text: On the etale site, paste the proper scalar-mate composition identity, open-unit composition identity and inverse-exchange mate square in a compatible tower. Apply the proper/open refinement identity and cancel common-refinement comparisons. The existing etale compact scalar coherence gives the equations in its normalization; identify it with the D-plus normalized definitions here.

Transport to the proetale site using the mixed scalar/site square, the site compositor coherence and the normalized refinement square. Cancel the invertible site comparisons and scalar/site balancing. Conjugate along alpha and beta using naturality of coefficient maps and geometric comparisons.

theorem finiteFree_geometric_squares
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : letI := φ.toAlgebra; Module.Finite A B ∧ Module.Free A B)
    (pro : Bool) {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Z]
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (c : Compactification f) (d : Compactification g) (e : Compactification (f ≫ g))
    {K : Sites.D pro A X}
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (α : (realization pro A X).obj L.obj ≅ K)
    (N : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (β : (realization pro B X).obj N.obj ≅ (Sites.scalar pro φ X).obj K) :
    (Sites.scalar pro φ Z).map (composition pro A c d e L α) ≫
        coefficientMap pro φ e K =
      coefficientMap pro φ d ((support pro A c).obj K) ≫
        (support pro B d).map (coefficientMap pro φ c K) ≫
          composition pro B c d e N β ∧
    ∀ (c' : Compactification f) (r : c'.Refinement c),
      (Sites.scalar pro φ Y).map (refinement pro A r L α) ≫
          coefficientMap pro φ c K =
        coefficientMap pro φ c' K ≫ refinement pro B r N β
